mechanism.claim: A weekly increase in standard CME Bitcoin asset-manager net share relative to the simultaneous change in Micro Bitcoin leveraged-money net share identifies institutional positioning that is not mirrored by the smaller-contract speculative segment. During elevated BTC variation, follow the sign of that cross-contract segmentation for one report cycle.
mechanism.side: strict sign of delta[(standard asset-manager long-short)/standard OI] minus delta[(micro leveraged-money long-short)/micro OI]
mechanism.why_distinct: CAMOP2W isolated standard-contract option positions and waited for a published second-week effect. CITA compared standard-contract participant classes. CFTCMSPS uses futures-only cross-contract segmentation between standard institutional and Micro leveraged-money positioning, no options, no prior event set, and no prior control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: prior-24h BTC realized variation must be in its causal upper half
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one conservative weekly external regulatory segmentation clock is absent from Gross9

features.source: official CFTC TFF futures-only annual files

standard_contract.name: BITCOIN - CHICAGO MERCANTILE EXCHANGE
standard_contract.position: Asset_Mgr_Positions_Long_All minus Asset_Mgr_Positions_Short_All, divided by Open_Interest_All

micro_contract.name: MICRO BITCOIN - CHICAGO MERCANTILE EXCHANGE
micro_contract.position: Lev_Money_Positions_Long_All minus Lev_Money_Positions_Short_All, divided by Open_Interest_All

features.weekly_changes: current net share minus immediately prior report net share; both contracts require exact consecutive report dates seven calendar days apart
features.segmentation: standard asset-manager share change minus micro leveraged-money share change; strict nonzero
features.conservative_availability: Tuesday report date plus seven calendar days 00:00 UTC
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact completed BTCUSDT 5m close/open log returns over the prior 24 hours); daily-boundary strict-prior midrank over 270 states, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.50

clock.reservation: weekly half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact held settlements only after novelty
clock.rv20: q90 audit only after all economics pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.btc: hash-bound completed 5m cache plus read-only Postgres extension through 2026-08-01
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no contract, participant class, normalization, threshold, side, lag, hold, clock, subset, source, or control repair.
